# Status checks to require on develop, staging and main (scripts/ci/setup_rulesets.sh reads
# this file; scripts/ci/test_setup_scripts.py ties every name to a job in .github/workflows).
#
# One check-run name per line, exactly as GitHub shows it on a PR. A job called through a
# reusable workflow is "<calling job name> / <called job name>"; a matrix job adds " (<value>)".
# setup_rulesets.sh binds each name to the GitHub Actions app (integration id 15368), so a
# commit status of the same name posted by anyone else cannot satisfy it.
#
# Rule for adding a name: its workflow runs on EVERY pull request into develop, staging and main
# (no `paths:` filter, no job-level `if:` that skips it on a PR) and blocks on a real failure. A
# required check that never reports leaves every PR "Expected - waiting" and unmergeable.
#
# Deliberately NOT required:
# - golden-freeze (chat-pipeline-golden.yml): runs only when its `paths:` match, and it is the
#   v1 golden suite, red on every branch since 6 Aug 2026 (153 known failures, MERGE_POLICY.md
#   "Current waivers"). Owner decision: v1 production stays untouched until v2 is complete.
# - gateway-v2 pytest shard N/M: the shard names change with the shard count. `gateway-v2
#   pytest` below fails unless every shard passed and the shards ran the whole suite.
# - Report-only scanners (SAST / bandit, dependencies / osv and npm-audit, infra lint /
#   trivy-config): they never fail on findings, only on a tool or network error, so requiring
#   them would block merges on outages without adding a gate. Their findings go to code scanning.
# - Code-scanning result checks ("CodeQL", "Semgrep OSS", "Bandit", "osv-scanner", "Trivy"):
#   GitHub's code-scanning app posts them, not Actions; use a `code_scanning` ruleset rule if
#   alerts should block (docs/ci/ENTERPRISE_SETUP.md).

# ci.yml
control (Django + Postgres + Redis) / django

# security.yml, CodeQL. NOTE: red on every PR and push since the move to the organisation
# (11 Nov 2026): CodeQL "default setup" was enabled for the repository then, and GitHub rejects
# the analyses this workflow uploads while default setup is on. Owner decision pending
# (docs/ci/ENTERPRISE_SETUP.md, step 2). Until it is switched to advanced setup, run
# setup_rulesets.sh with --without-codeql, or every merge is blocked.
